lines.text: Mary hurries to a town in the hill country of Judah and enters the home of Zechariah.
When Elizabeth hears Mary's greeting, her baby leaps in her womb, and she is filled with the Holy Spirit.
Elizabeth calls Mary the mother of her Lord and says her baby leaped for fear.
Mary says God has brought down rulers from their thrones, exalted the humble, and filled the hungry with good things.
God helped His servant Israel as He promised Isaac, and Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months.
